response.overview: Planet of the Plates is a breathtaking science and nature documentary that uncovers the latest breakthroughs in plate tectonics. Filmed across 15 global geologic hotspots—stretching from the frozen expanses of Antarctica to the volcanic valleys of Tanzania—this film unpacks the mysterious, deep-earth forces intimately tied to the existence of life on our planet. Through stunning cinematography and expert insights, it explores how the violent shifting of Earth's crust is not just a destructive force, but the very engine that shapes, regulates, and sustains the living world.
response.title: Planet of the Plates
